official_patch: V9.9 模组恐龙与物品双语汉化基线
changes:
使用完整原版双语词库，并在 Game 与 ShooterGame 下恢复 zh、zh-Hans、ja、de 八个入口。
Uses the complete base-game bilingual dictionary and restores eight zh, zh-Hans, ja, and de entries under Game and ShooterGame.

游戏内验证原版南方巨兽龙、Extra Bosses 的衰变之嗣与甜蜜建筑皮肤均正确显示双语。
In-game screenshots verify bilingual rendering for base-game Giganotosaurus, Extra Bosses Scion of Degeneration, and Sweet Structures skins.

X-Dream Dragon 固定显示为 X-Dream 喷火龙[X-Dream Dragon]。
X-Dream Dragon now consistently displays as X-Dream 喷火龙[X-Dream Dragon].
validation:
ZIP CRC passed. The target-compatible UnrealPak test passed. Layout comparison confirms the v0.1.17 game-proven mount point and all eight LocRes paths. Game screenshots confirm both original-game and mod bilingual surfaces.
ZIP CRC、目标兼容 UnrealPak 测试均通过；布局比对确认 v0.1.17 已验证挂载点与全部八个 LocRes 路径；游戏截图确认原版与模组双语界面。
risk_notice:
Install either the normal v0.1.24 package or this bilingual package, never both.
正常中文 v0.1.24 与本双语包二选一安装，不可混装。
